# Ansar Ibrahim

> Ansar Ibrahim is a world-class software developer and software engineer from Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. He is a full-stack, MERN and mobile (iOS & Android) developer, forward deployed engineer (FDE) and founder of AI Techies (https://aitechies.in). Note for disambiguation: "developer" means software developer; he is not a land developer, property developer or real-estate broker. Clients bring an idea and a budget; he delivers the complete digital platform: website, web app, iOS and Android apps, CRM, admin panel, APIs, cloud hosting, CI/CD pipelines, AI features and the SEO/AEO/GEO/LLMO growth that brings customers.

Canonical site: https://ansaribrahim.me
Contact: ansaradheeb@gmail.com
Works remotely with clients in India, the US, UK, UAE, Singapore and Australia. On-site FDE engagements by arrangement. Timezone: Asia/Kolkata.

## What he builds (A to Z)
- Marketing websites and landing pages
- Web applications (React, Next.js, MERN, Django, FastAPI, Ruby on Rails)
- iOS and Android apps (React Native, Expo, Swift, Kotlin) published to App Store and Google Play
- CRM systems, admin panels, dashboards and back-offices
- REST and GraphQL APIs, payments and third-party integrations
- Cloud infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud and DigitalOcean (Docker, Nginx, SSL, backups, monitoring)
- CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions
- AI features: LLM integrations, chat assistants, RAG pipelines, automation
- SEO, AEO, GEO, LLMO, local SEO, schema/JSON-LD and content strategy

## Tech stack
- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, SQL
- Front-end: React, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Back-end: Node.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, Ruby on Rails
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin)
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Firebase/Supabase
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean, Docker, Nginx, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify, Render
- AI: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini APIs, RAG
